title: Billionaire Steve Wynn's Beverly Hills estate sells for $47.75M after five years on the market
summary_full: Billionaire Steve Wynn's Beverly Hills mansion has finally sold for $47.75 million.  The lavish estate, known as Villa Lulu, was on the market for over five years.  After extensive renovations and price adjustments, the property found a buyer.  This sale highlights challenges in the ultra-luxury real estate market.  The transaction concludes a significant chapter in Los Angeles' high-end property sales.
